verdict.rationale: An observability platform could plausibly ship autonomous background automations such as agentic investigations or scheduled AI workflows, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only adjacent pieces: alert rules, service-account API access for the user's own automation scripts, and an MCP server and Agent Skills that external AI assistants use on demand. None of these is a product-native automation that runs autonomously in the background.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
